milestone: FROM-SCRATCH LINE at 164.038568 mm - the first move ever produced by a pose-changing entry mode (mode 29, joint re-placement) from a perturbed parent, and the measurement of the mechanism's two structural constants: pose-grid quantum 0.001 mm, ejection limit 7 pieces
machine: x86_64, Intel(R) Core(TM) Ultra 7 270K Plus, 16 cores, runs pinned at 8 threads
experiment: modes 27/28/29 on the legal parent and on perturbed states, 585 runs; the productive perturbation is a FRONTIER FLATTEN (every piece deeper than frontier - delta moved in by exactly its own excess, delta 0.002-0.004 mm) handed to mode 29 with a LOOSE bound

mechanism.whatWorks: frontier flatten delta 0.002-0.004 mm -> exactly 1 violating pair in a 2-piece component -> mode 29 ejects both, re-places them jointly on the first order tried (ordersTried=1), exact validator accepts at 164.038568
mechanism.whatFails: the pv36 nudge at d=1-2 mm is the WRONG perturbation for these modes: it manufactures a 1.75 mm material deficit in a 6-piece component the re-placement cannot house; every sub-incumbent clamp fails because the bound gates acceptance of the re-placed pose rather than driving it shallower - the bound must be LOOSE
mechanism.responseCurve: delta sweep 0.0005..0.010 step 0.0005: productive band delta in [0.002, 0.004]

structuralConstants.poseGridQuantum: 0.001 mm - every mode 28/29 publication lands on RAW + n*0.001 (grid_key snap); the -0.001 mm move is the minimum non-zero move this mechanism can make
structuralConstants.ejectionLimit: 7 pieces - frontier ranks 1-8 lie within 0.0225 mm, rank 9 jumps to 0.109 mm, so any perturbation deep enough to buy >=0.1 mm displaces 8+ pieces and trips 'ejection set exceeds the local-repair limit of 7'; the mechanism is structurally capped at ~0.02 mm per move on this basin
